		if = {
			limit = { gold >= 220 }
			add = 20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { gold < 160 }
			value = 0
		}
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior 10 = regular }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:clergy_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_wp35_civ_syn_hindustani.a
		effect = {
			add_gold = -100
			set_variable = { name = oe_wp35_civ_syn_hindustani_done value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_wp35_civ.19
		}
	}
}

oe_wp35_civ_syn_creole_atlantic = {
	decision_category = country_specific_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_year >= 1337
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }

		gold >= 100

	ai_will_do = {

		if = {
			limit = { gold >= 220 }
			add = 20
		}
		if = {

			value = 0
		}
	}

		}
